ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there are three input terminals, respectively labeled A, B, C; they are connected to the same gate circuit; the output terminal on the right side of the gate circuit has an inversion small circle, and the output is labeled F, indicating that this is a three-input NOR gate. Reasoning: The output of this circuit is F = not(A + B + C). The problem requires implementing F = not(A + B). In order to make the extra input C not affect the OR operation, C should be connected to logic 0, because A + B + 0 = A + B. Therefore F = not(A + B + 0) = not(A + B).
